title: Da Vinci Banquet Halls — product init
question: Who is the primary person this marketing site must win, and what job are they trying to finish?

options.label: Wedding couples / families
options.thesis: Couples and parents shortlisting venues for a wedding or multi-day celebration.
options.case: Success = they book a tour or submit an inquiry with date and guest count.
options.body: Primary: engaged couples and wedding decision-makers in the GTA comparing banquet halls.

options.label: South Asian celebration hosts
options.thesis: Families planning South Asian weddings, receptions, and cultural celebrations who need space + catering fit.
options.case: Success = they see cuisine packages and halls as a credible match and inquire.
options.body: Primary: hosts of South Asian weddings and cultural events who need capacity and menu alignment.

options.label: Corporate / event planners
options.thesis: Planners booking corporate parties, meetings, fundraisers, or trade-adjacent events.
options.case: Success = they confirm availability and catering options quickly.
options.body: Primary: corporate or professional event organizers evaluating space, AV, and service.

options.label: Equal mix — don't prioritize one
options.thesis: Weddings, South Asian celebrations, corporate, and social events share equal weight.
options.case: Site must serve all event types without a single hero audience.
options.body: No single primary; marketing must work across all confirmed event types.
